text: What did the man with the horse mean to do?
why: The man's track beside the horse's turns toward King's Pyland and then comes back, so a reader would naturally ask what he intended.

text: What did the man with the horse mean to do? — to lead the horse home to King's Pyland, then to hide him
id: q.track_man_aim=to lead the horse home to King's Pyland, then to hide him
why: The tracks head toward King's Pyland and then return the opposite way. Starting to lead the horse home and then changing course to conceal him is a reasonable reading.

text: What did the man with the horse mean to do? — to hide the horse from the start
id: q.track_man_aim=to hide the horse from the start
why: The horse has not been found and Holmes suspects he is at Mapleton, so hiding him all along is an open possibility a reader could weigh.
